`hydra.py` is the unmodified reference implementation by Angus Dempster,
Daniel F. Schmidt, and Geoffrey I. Webb, downloaded on 2026-11-11 from
https://github.com/angus924/hydra/blob/main/code/hydra.py.

Upstream license: GPL-3.0, included in HYDRA_LICENSE. The benchmark protocol
records the exact SHA-256 of the downloaded source. No installation or model
weights are required. This adapter runs on CPU with four Torch threads.
